code-reviewer.when_to_use: When the diff contains executable code. General correctness: bugs, logic, contracts, data flow, security. Anchor agent for code-shaped diffs.

simplifier.when_to_use: Diff introduces abstractions, new utilities, refactors, or non-trivial structural change.

silent-failure-hunter.when_to_use: Diff contains try/catch, error handling, fallbacks, or async flows.

test-auditor.when_to_use: Diff changes behavior, contracts, or business logic. Always for plan/fix verification.

consistency-auditor.when_to_use: When the diff touches an area with established patterns, follows a spec/plan, OR is itself a spec/design/prose artifact whose conformity to codebase patterns and directives needs to be assessed. Anchor agent for prose-only diffs.

implementer.when_to_use: Default writer-capable agent for /comb:fix and /comb:plan. Full tool access. Override per-project to plug in a specialist writer.
